connection: per-call sqlite3.connect via get_connection() helper (sqlite3 stdlib)
queries: SELECT * FROM books with a title LIKE filter, then optional category and max-price filters applied in Python after fetching
n_plus_one: none: single candidate query plus in-memory filtering

optimization_targets.description: Push the optional category and max-price filters into the SQL WHERE clause so the database returns only matching rows instead of filtering in Python

notes: Search results must keep title match, optional category equality, price at most the given maximum, and descending publication-date ordering
